JOYSTAR Neo Kids Mountain Bike - 20/24 Inch
Empower your young rider to conquer the trails with the JOYSTAR Neo 20"24" Mountain Bike. Designed for kids aged 5-12, this rugged bicycle bridges the gap between sidewalk cruising and real riding adventures, featuring a sleek frame and trail-ready components.

The JOYSTAR Neo: Adventure-ready performance for first-time mountain bikers.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted for the bold, the Neo provides the stability beginners need and the durability mountain biking demands."
Superior Control & Reliability
The JOYSTAR Neo features a robust HI-TEN steel mountain bike frame designed to handle a variety of terrains, from neighborhood paths to dirt trails. To ensure safe stopping as riders gain speed, it utilizes a dual-braking system: a front caliper handbrake and a rear coaster brake, allowing for intuitive control at any stage of the learning process.

Precision front handbrake and rear coaster brake for ultimate safety.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth-Friendly: Equipped with a quick-release adjustable seat to grow alongside your child.

Confidence Building: Includes heavy-duty detachable training wheels for beginners, which can be removed as they master balance.

Trail Grip: Rugged 20" / 24"x 2.125" pneumatic rubber tires provide exceptional traction and stability on multiple surfaces.

Rugged Extras: Features a protective chain guard, resin pedals, and a sport-inspired comfort saddle.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Spend less time in the garage and more time on the trail. The JOYSTAR Neo arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included basic tools and simple instructions, the final setup of the front wheel, seat, and pedals takes approximately 20 minutes.

Hassle-Free Assembly: Watch how quickly your Neo gets ready for action.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Conquering New Terrain: The JOYSTAR Neo in its natural habitat.

Our Guarantee
We stand behind the quality of every Neo bicycle to ensure your peace of mind:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Our steel frames are guaranteed against faulty materials for as long as you own the bike.

2-Year Component Coverage: Non-wear parts like forks and handlebars are protected for 2 years.

Registration Bonus: While the standard warranty is robust, JOYSTAR often extends a Limited Lifetime Warranty to the original owner if the bike is registered on our official website shortly after purchase.

Customer Support: Our team is ready to assist with any issues or assembly questions to ensure a safe ride.
